newsitem.title: UK: Barclays, banks higher after WSJ report.
newsitem.headline: Barclays, banks higher after WSJ report.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Bank Plc led UK bank stocks higher on Wednesday after positive comment on the sector in the Wall Street Journal newspaper, dealers said.
A report in the European edition of the paper said the outlook for earnings growth at UK clearing banks next year was positive, despite expectations of further interest rate rises.
By 1010 GMT Barclays was 12p higher at 10.10 stg, National Westminster Bank was up nine at 676 and Lloyds TSB Group was up six pence at 423. Abbey National Plc was up 8-1/2p at 730-1/2.
The Journal said the buoyant returns on some banking stocks enjoyed this year could be replicated in 1997.
It said the average share price increase of the UK's eight largest banks over the past 12 months was 13 percent, compared with a 7.6 percent gain in the FTSE-100 index.
